declared: 2026-11-14 13:35 UTC, before any pool-head trace on a benchmark campaign or the synthetic gate

arms.TabPFN35-PoolHead: pool head (pool_head.py, rl.py checkpoint at iteration 100) on TabPFN-3.5
arms.TabPFN3x-PoolHead: the same head trained on TabPFN-3 (v3_default via tabpfn 9.2.0)

primary_selection: the primary is the backbone whose head gains more over its own base rule on the held-out synthetic gate (20 mixed-prior pools x 4 seeds, mean of the Top-5% and best-value gains), fixed before any campaign is run

campaigns.why: small pools where a non-TabPFN arm is the best of the 56 (AutoAM: GP-ARD-greedy; benzylation: GP-MLP-UCB2; colors_bob: GP-MLP-UCB1; fullerenes: GP-iso-UCB2)

comparisons: the head's own base rule on the same backbone (PTop on liang, EI on olympus)
tests: all protocol seeds (50 liang, 100 olympus), paired; Wilcoxon over seeds per campaign; NI-AUC in the 56-arm field + one arm
no_tuning: no head or training change after any campaign result
